sources: Lanlan repo (all verified against vendor official pages)
freetokens.fyi (all verified against vendor official pages)
meta.note: Quota wording transcribed from vendor official pages; no currency conversion. Check the official page before claiming. Text translated from data/offers.json; all facts identical.

offers.title: Spark-X2.6 free trial credits
offers.quotaText: 1 billion tokens
risks: Only designated models such as Spark-X2.6
offers.steps: Open the Spark MaaS platform → register and complete real-name verification → claim the Spark-X2.6 free trial credits on the platform → create an API key and call the API.
offers.resetNote: One-time claim; credit validity as shown in the console
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: New-user free credits (over 70M tokens across models)
offers.quotaText: About 1M tokens per model, valid 90 days
risks: Free credits only in the North China 2 (Beijing) region
Switches to pay-as-you-go when exhausted by default — turn on “stop when exhausted”
offers.steps: Complete Alibaba Cloud real-name verification → enable Bailian (choose the North China 2 / Beijing region) → credits are issued automatically → turn on “stop when exhausted” in the console to avoid charges.
offers.resetNote: Issued automatically after activation; each model counted separately; expires after 90 days
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: New-user token gift pack
offers.quotaText: 20M tokens + 120 image/video generations
offers.steps: Open the Zhipu open platform → register with a phone number → complete real-name verification → the gift pack is issued to your account automatically → create an API key.
offers.resetNote: One-time gift pack; validity as shown in the console
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: GLM-4.5-Flash / GLM-4.7-Flash free models
offers.quotaText: Officially marked fully free; concurrency shown per account
risks: Only the Flash series is free; flagship models are paid
offers.steps: Register on the Zhipu open platform → create an API key → set the model name to glm-4.5-flash or glm-4.7-flash and call directly.
offers.resetNote: Long-term free models; no claim needed; call right after registering
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: New-user 1M tokens per model trial pack
offers.quotaText: 1M tokens per model, valid 1 year
risks: Once the free credits run out, postpaid billing must be enabled to continue
offers.steps: Log in to Tencent Cloud → open the TokenHub console model square → claim under “New user benefits”, or claim automatically on first call.
offers.resetNote: Once per master account; campaign runs until 2026-12-31
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: New-user all-model resource pack
offers.quotaText: 3M tokens
risks: Switches to pay-as-you-go when used up — watch your balance
offers.steps: Register on Qiniu Cloud → open AI Inference → create your first API key → the 3M-token resource pack is issued automatically (may take a while).
offers.resetNote: Issued automatically after creating your first API key or first trial
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Signup credits + real-name verification voucher
offers.quotaText: ¥14 credit on signup; invite + real-name verification earns a ¥16 voucher (180 days)
offers.steps: Register on SiliconFlow → complete real-name verification → the ¥14 credit is issued; claim the ¥16 voucher on the campaign page.
offers.resetNote: One-time credit; voucher valid 180 days
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: New-user free trial benefit
offers.quotaText: ¥15 voucher, valid 3 months
risks: Voucher does not apply to the K3 model
offers.steps: Register on the Kimi open platform → complete real-name verification → the ¥15 voucher applies to API calls automatically.
offers.resetNote: Issued to the API account automatically after real-name verification
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Public-beta shared credit pool
offers.quotaText: 120,000 credits per rolling 5 hours / 1,200,000 per week
risks: Public-beta benefit; may change later
offers.steps: Register on the SenseNova platform → verify your phone number → create an sk- API key in the console → call models such as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
offers.resetNote: Dual limits: rolling 5-hour window + weekly window; public-beta benefit
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: API-Inference daily free credits
offers.quotaText: 250 magic particles per day (200 check-in + 50 for binding Alibaba Cloud)
offers.steps: Log in to ModelScope → check in to get 200 magic particles → bind an Alibaba Cloud account for 50 more → call API-Inference with an access token.
offers.resetNote: Resets daily; unused credits do not roll over
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Daily free tokens
offers.quotaText: 500,000 tokens per day (input + output)
risks: Verified a while ago — check the actual credits in the console before claiming
offers.steps: Register on the Ling developer platform with a +86 phone number → daily credits are issued automatically → call the API per the docs.
offers.resetNote: Issued before 02:00 daily; no rollover
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Promo models daily free tokens
offers.quotaText: 10M tokens per day, first come first served
risks: Verified a while ago; may have changed
First come, first served until gone
offers.steps: Log in to Huawei Cloud CodeArts → pick a promo model (DeepSeek / GLM Flash series) → call directly within the daily credits.
offers.resetNote: Resets at 24:00 (UTC+8) daily, first come first served
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Token Factory free model API
offers.quotaText: Free calls within the daily pts usage cap
risks: Trial-oriented; not for production
Exact credits as shown under “Points & usage” in the console
offers.steps: Register and log in at developer.amd.com.cn → open Token Factory → copy the rc- API key and call.
offers.resetNote: Resets at 00:00 Beijing time; daily credits vary by account
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: K2-Horizon daily free credits
offers.quotaText: 10M tokens per key per day (input + output)
risks: Console display and docs occasionally differ — go by your account
offers.steps: Register on the IFM platform → create an API key → call K2-Horizon in OpenAI format.
offers.resetNote: Resets at 00:00 UTC
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: :free free models
offers.quotaText: 20 RPM / 50 requests per day; 1,000 per day after the account has been topped up $10
risks: Failed requests also count toward the daily cap
The free model list changes
offers.steps: Register on OpenRouter → create an API key → call models whose IDs end in :free; one key works across many providers’ models.
offers.resetNote: Resets daily; model IDs end in :free
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Free Plan fast inference
offers.quotaText: Per model: 30 RPM / 1,000 requests per day / 200K tokens per day
risks: Limits are calculated per organization and per model
offers.steps: Register on GroqCloud → create an API key → call open models such as gpt-oss and Qwen; speed is its selling point.
offers.resetNote: Per-model rate limits; resets daily
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Gemini API free tier
offers.quotaText: Free tier for Gemini Flash and other models, 5–30 RPM / per-model daily caps
risks: Free-tier data may be used to improve Google products
Requires network access to Google
offers.steps: Log in to AI Studio → create an API key → call Gemini Flash / Flash-Lite; long context up to 1M.
offers.resetNote: Resets daily; actual limits as shown in the AI Studio quota panel
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Daily free Neurons
offers.quotaText: 10,000 Neurons per day
risks: Some newer models require a payment method first
offers.steps: Enable Cloudflare Workers AI → call per the docs; both free and paid plans include 10,000 Neurons per day.
offers.resetNote: Resets at 00:00 UTC (08:00 Beijing time)
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Inference trial credits
offers.quotaText: $5 free credit, expires in 30 days
risks: Card required
No long-term free tier — don’t treat it as daily credits
offers.steps: Register on Cerebras Inference → bind a payment method for verification → call public models once the $5 credit is issued.
offers.resetNote: One-time trial credit, expires 30 days after grant; daily cap 1M tokens
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: New-user Sandbox promo credits
offers.quotaText: $100 promo credit, valid 90 days (Sandbox only)
risks: Sandbox only — not a general balance
offers.steps: Register on Novita AI → promo credits are issued automatically → call the full model catalog in the Sandbox environment.
offers.resetNote: One-time credit, usable only in the Novita Sandbox
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Free tier monthly credits
offers.quotaText: $5 Gateway credits per month
risks: Card required
Available models are a subset, with rate limits
offers.steps: Enable AI Gateway with a Vercel team account → the monthly $5 free credits start counting after the first request.
offers.resetNote: Monthly cycle counted from the first Gateway request
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Free public translation API
offers.quotaText: Call directly with no registration; no cap stated on the official site
risks: Translation only (150 languages) — not a general chat model
offers.steps: Point the Base URL to index-translate.bilibili.com/v1 in OpenAI format, model name Index-Translate-35B-A3B; callable without a key.
offers.resetNote: Long-term free; no registration, no key needed
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Daily credits in the desktop app
offers.quotaText: 100 credits per day, each batch valid 30 days
risks: Usable only inside the Qoder client
offers.steps: Open the Qoder desktop app → claim today’s 100 credits at the campaign entry → each day’s batch is usable for 30 days.
offers.resetNote: Claim daily inside the Qoder desktop app
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Trial edition free credits
offers.quotaText: 500 credits/month, valid within the month, no rollover
risks: Usable only inside the client
offers.steps: Download WorkBuddy → log in with WeChat or a phone number → the trial edition gets 500 credits per month automatically.
offers.resetNote: Issued monthly; unused credits expire at month end
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Hunyuan Hy4 limited-time free access
offers.quotaText: Free credits gifted daily, Nov 4–15
risks: Limited-time campaign, ends Nov 15
offers.steps: Download WorkBuddy or CodeBuddy → log in → pick “Hunyuan Hy4” in the model selector to use the free credits.
offers.resetNote: Gifted daily during the campaign; subscribers get more
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: New-user credits
offers.quotaText: 250 credits on first login, valid 14 days
risks: Usable only inside the app
offers.steps: Register on CodeBuddy International → first login → 250 credits are issued automatically.
offers.resetNote: One-time new-user gift, expires after 14 days
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Daily check-in credits
offers.quotaText: 100 per daily check-in + 500 per monthly login + 2,000 on registration
risks: Usable only inside the client
offers.steps: Open TRAE CN → check in daily for 100 credits → use GLM and Seed series models for coding.
offers.resetNote: Check-in refreshes daily; invite credits also available
offers.sourceName: freetokens.fyi · verified against official page

offers.title: Student plan free for one year
offers.quotaText: 1,000 credits/month × 12 months, no rollover
risks: Students only, must be 18 or older
Schools not on the list can register interest
offers.steps: Register on Kiro → pick your school under Settings → Students → verify student status via SheerID → 1,000 credits per month are issued.
offers.resetNote: Issued monthly, no rollover across months; no card required
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Sandbox free-edition model message credits
offers.quotaText: 200 model message credits + 5,000 API calls per month
risks: Credits are deducted by model type; flagship models cost more
offers.steps: Register on Dify Cloud → Sandbox edition by default → use the 200 message credits to try OpenAI, Gemini, Qwen and other models to build apps.
offers.resetNote: Sandbox free edition by default on registration; bring your own key when credits run out
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Search API free tier
offers.quotaText: 1,000 API credits per month, no card required
offers.steps: Register on Tavily → get an API key in the console → plug web search and page extraction into your agent.
offers.resetNote: Resets on the 1st of each month
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Scrape/search free tier
offers.quotaText: 1,000 credits per month, no card required
offers.steps: Register on Firecrawl → get an API key → use the scrape/search endpoints to feed web content to your agent.
offers.resetNote: Resets monthly; roughly 1,000 pages
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Search API Starter free credits
offers.quotaText: $10 per month + $10 signup gift, no card required
offers.steps: Click “Start for free” on the Exa pricing page → register and get an API key → credits offset search and content endpoints on a metered basis.
offers.resetNote: $10 credits per month, plus a $10 onboarding bonus on signup
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Web Search API (MCP) free daily
offers.quotaText: 100 searches per day, no account, no key
risks: Overage billed at $5 per 1,000 searches
offers.steps: Add the You.com MCP server to your AI client per the official docs → 100 free web searches per day, no registration.
offers.resetNote: Resets daily; called via the MCP server
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Code sandbox Hobby credits
offers.quotaText: $100 one-time usage credits, no card required
offers.steps: Click “Start for Free” on the E2B pricing page → register for Hobby → $100 sandbox credits are issued for running agent code.
offers.resetNote: One-time credits, until used up
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Starter monthly free compute
offers.quotaText: $30 free credits per month
offers.steps: Register on Modal → choose Starter → $30 compute credits per month take effect automatically; good for inference and batch jobs.
offers.resetNote: Issued monthly; overage billed at GPU/CPU list prices
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Browser automation Launch credits
offers.quotaText: $30 one-time credits, no card required
offers.steps: Open the Steel pricing page → start the free Launch plan → $30 credits for agent browser sessions.
offers.resetNote: One-time credits, with concurrent session limits
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Free tokens with a new API key

offers.steps: Open Jina → get an API key → 10M free tokens are attached to the key automatically, usable for Reader web fetching and embedding models.
offers.resetNote: One-time credits; check balance under API Key & Billing
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: First embedding tokens free
offers.quotaText: First 200M embedding tokens per account free
offers.steps: Register on Voyage (MongoDB account) → call voyage-4 series embedding models → the first 200M tokens are not billed.

offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Document parsing free tier
offers.quotaText: 10,000 credits per month
offers.steps: Click “Start for free” on the pricing page → register → 10,000 credits per month for parsing PDFs/documents for your agent.
offers.resetNote: Resets monthly; basic parsing from 1 credit/page
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Inference Starter free credits
offers.quotaText: 5M embedding tokens per model per month + 500 reranks/month
offers.steps: Click “Start for Free” to open Starter → call inference models such as llama-text-embed-v2; monthly free credits offset automatically.
offers.resetNote: Issued monthly, separately per model

offers.title: Speech API signup credits
offers.quotaText: $200 free credits, no card required, never expire
offers.steps: Open the Deepgram pricing page → register for free → $200 credits are issued for STT/TTS/Voice Agent.
offers.resetNote: One-time credits, never expire; roughly hundreds of hours of transcription
offers.sourceName: Lanlan repo · verified against official page

offers.title: Speech transcription signup credits
offers.quotaText: $50 free credits, no card required
offers.steps: Open the AssemblyAI pricing page → register and get an API key → $50 credits for transcription and Speech Understanding.
offers.resetNote: One-time credits; lower concurrency on the free tier

offers.title: Builder bundle credits
offers.quotaText: $25 inference credits + $25 Tavily + $100 LangSmith, etc.
